plot_single_ascii: plot a single logs.tsv file as an ASCII chart with rolling average and error bars
plot_multiple_ascii: plot multiple logs.tsv files from a directory as overlaid ASCII charts with legends
collect_logs: collect and parse all logs.tsv files matching a target directory path into dataframes
str_to_float_pair: convert a comma-separated string like '0,100' into a tuple of two floats
plot_cli: run the argparse CLI to plot NLE agent results from logs.tsv files to ASCII charts
